titleTr: Okul binası ve sınıflar: where ve whose

explainTr: Bir yeri tanımlamak için 'where' kullanırsın: The library is the place where students borrow books. 'Where' kendi başına 'in which' anlamını taşır, bu yüzden cümlenin sonuna 'in' veya 'there' eklemezsin.
Sahiplik (kimin?) için 'whose' kullanırsın ve hemen ardından bir isim gelir: She is the teacher whose classroom is next to the gym. 'Whose' ile 'who's' (who is) karıştırılmamalı.
Her ikisi de ana cümlenin içinde bir ismi tanımlar: the room where..., the boy whose...
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'sınıfı spor salonunun yanında olan öğretmen' diye uzun bir sıfat-fiil kurarsın. İngilizcede aynı fikri sona koyarsın: the teacher whose classroom is next to the gym.

reading.title: Finding Room 114
reading.text:
It is Hafsa's first day as a substitute, and she is looking for Room 114. She has a map, but it is hard to read. Lincoln Elementary is a big building that has two floors and four hallways.

At the entrance, she meets a girl whose backpack is almost bigger than she is. "Excuse me, do you know where Room 114 is?" Hafsa asks. "Yes! It's the room where Mr. Ortiz teaches fourth grade," the girl says. "Go down this hallway and turn left after the library. The library is the place where we borrow books. It is next to the gym." Hafsa thanks her and walks away.

She finds the room, but the door is locked. A custodian whose keys make a loud noise comes by and opens it for her. "This is the room where the students keep their art supplies," he says. Inside, Hafsa finds a note on the desk from Mr. Ortiz, whose handwriting is very neat. "Welcome! The lesson plan is in the blue folder. Lunch is at 11:45 in the cafeteria. If you need help, ask Ms. Lopez, whose classroom is across the hall."

Hafsa takes a deep breath. The school is not so scary now. She knows where everything is, and she knows whose door to knock on.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: Welcome, Hafsa. Let me show you where things are.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you. Where is the restroom for teachers?

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: It's at the end of this hallway, near the stairs. The students' restrooms are downstairs.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: And where do I take my class for lunch?

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: To the cafeteria. It's the big room where you smell pizza on Fridays.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: What about the gym? Do the children go there every day?

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: The gym is where they have recess when it rains. In sunny weather they go to the playground.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Whose coat is that on the floor?

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: It belongs to a boy whose locker is broken. I'll take it to the office.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez
script.text: That's where the fifth graders do experiments. It's locked, so ask Mr. Brown for the key.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Great. I think I understand now.

script.speaker: Ms. Lopez

writing.promptTr: Bir okulu ya da iş yerini anlat: 3 yeri 'where' ile, 2 kişiyi 'whose' ile tanıt (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Describe a school or a workplace. Use where for three places and whose for two people. (80-120 words)
frames: The library is the place where ...
The gym is the room where ...
I think this is a school where ...
writing.model: Last week I visited Lincoln Elementary School. It is a big school with a lot of nice places. The library is the place where students read quietly. The gym is the room where they play basketball. The playground is a place where children run at recess. I met Ms. Lopez, whose classroom is near the entrance. She is a teacher whose students really love her. I also met a boy whose backpack was bigger than he was! I think this is a school where I can learn a lot. Maybe I can work there someday.
checklistTr: Sahiplik için 'whose' + isim yazdın mı (whose classroom)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?

The auditorium is a large room where schools hold concerts. On Friday, a class whose teacher is sick will watch a movie there. Mr. Brown will put a sign on the door.
